name: read-only-baseline
description: The policy the framework configuration names. Declared, not framework-enforced: the read-only guarantee is the RBAC grant Azure Resource Manager enforces, and this layer is defence in depth (SEC-001, FR-53).

denyRules.justification: v1 observes and never mutates. Denied here as well as absent from the allow list, so removing the allow list does not remove the prohibition.
No deletion, scaling or restart. An operation that cannot be undone must not be reachable from a policy intended to be defence in depth.
No command or query is constructed at run time. Only a reviewed, catalogued query can run, which is what makes the surface reviewable.
No credential is read. Every sensitive value is an external reference the agent resolves through its identity, never a value it retrieves and holds.
A single principal must not both propose and authorise. The approval ledger exists to record that separation.
No finding leaves the environment. Publication is how an observation about a customer estate becomes a disclosure.
The agent does not create recurring work. A schedule it authored would outlive the execution that was reviewed.
